_about: Every public-domain Thomas Brooks (1608-1680) text the Word Hoard holds. The target is Grosart's Complete Works (Nichol's Series of Standard Divines, 6 vols, 1866-1867), Internet Archive OCR text (University of Toronto scans, volume numbers read off the title-page OCR), raw and unconverted (the Edwards precedent). CCEL has no Brooks author page (ccel.org/ccel/brooks returned 404 on 2026-10-02) and no Gutenberg Brooks exists, so there is no clean text yet. Modern reprints are excluded. Many other Thomas Brookses are on IA; only the Puritan (1608-1680) is held.
